title: Resolve unit references
responsibility: Create links for registered or currently viewed units within the captured workspace scope.

inputs.name: unitLinks.workspace
inputs.description: Supplies the snapshot, selected entity, busy state, pin state and route scope used to resolve references. Without a snapshot the resolver always returns null; busy state or a changed project, branch, commit or pin state prevents resolution.

inputs.name: unitLinks.current
inputs.description: Defaults to null. The entity is used only when it matches the workspace selected entity, and only as a fallback when the requested ID is not in the snapshot catalog.

inputs.name: unitLinks.options
inputs.description: Defaults to an empty object. When history is true, generated routes use the history suffix; omitted or false history uses no suffix.

outputs.name: unitLinks
outputs.description: Returns a resolver that finds IDs in the snapshot catalog, falling back only to the matching loaded entity, and yields a link with to, name and category or null. It yields null for non-unit or missing IDs, while the workspace is busy, or after the shown project, branch, commit or pin state changes; routes include a commit only for pinned views.
